subject: Provisional safety fuel for peak corridor - HexaCommerce POC
messages:
From: Brian Taylor <brian@hexacorp.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Quick request - need temporary headroom for POC ramp

Neha,

Thanks again for the call today — the HexaCommerce infra team will start the end-to-end POC on Monday and we’ve got a narrower window than expected for the throughput soak. Can Redwood provision an extra 150k token-equivalent credits for a 36-hour window (Nov 30 00:00 - Dec 1 12:00 PST)? The main aim is to validate sustained 1k TPS API hits and tail-latency under 150ms on our subset. If you need it scoped differently we can split it into an evening-only 12h run.

I attached our load plan (hexa_load_plan_v2.xlsx) and a short note on SLA tolerances. We can sign a quick mutual action plan if that helps.

Appreciate a fast yes/no — the infra team needs time to front-load test rigs.

—Brian
Principal DevOps, HexaCommerce
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Brian Taylor <brian@hexacorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick request - need temporary headroom for POC ramp

Brian —

Thanks for the details and the plan. We can absolutely support a 36-hour elevated allowance but need internal sign-off for the 150k token-equivalent uplift. Before I lock this in, two quick clarifications:

- Confirmed run window you want Redwood to enable? You listed Nov 30 - Dec 1; is that PST?
- Is the 1k TPS target steady-state or bursty (i.e., 1k sustained vs 1k bursts for 30s)?
- Do you need dedicated instances (Reserved/Dedicated) or is hosted API + higher quota OK? Dedicated requires a 48h setup.

I’m pulling in Karthik and Marissa to expedite approvals; if they sign off today I can provision the allowance and share an access token with the Hexa team.

Action: I’ll follow up internally and confirm by EOD.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick request - need temporary headroom for POC ramp

Neha — looping in Ops and Capacity for a quick check. TL;DR: Hexa wants +150k tokens for 36h to validate 1k TPS sustained.

Internal notes for approval:
- Risk: Hosted API can handle the delta if we enable KV caching and set a per-token cap; cost estimate at current rates ~ $1,200 for the window (we should offer a promo discount).
- If they want dedicated instances we need to provision and test GPU nodes (2x A10 equivalent) — that adds setup time and cost.
- Approve conditional: grant 36h hosted uplift with a 20% promo credit applied and a post-run performance debrief scheduled with Solutions Eng.

Marissa — can you greenlight the promo and confirm budget code? Jonas — can you flag to infra to reserve ephemeral capacity for Nov 30 00:00 PST (standby)? If we see tail-latency >200ms at any point, auto-fallback to the smaller model variant should be enabled.

Karthik
Director, Customer Success Ops
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick request - need temporary headroom for POC ramp

All — approved.

Decision and next steps:
1) Approve hosted API uplift of 150k token-equivalent credits for HexaCommerce from Nov 30 00:00 PST to Dec 1 12:00 PST.
2) Apply 20% promotional allowance (internal promo code: POC-EXPEDITE-20).
3) Infra (Jonas) to mark ephemeral capacity standby and add autoscaling policy: fallback -> smaller-quantized model if sustained tail-latency > 180ms for 90s.
4) Neha to send confirmation to Hexa and attach the temporary API key + link to runbook.

Attachments for customer: poc-agg-sla-notes.pdf (summary of fallback policy + contact list).

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Growth | Redwood Inference
